name: Sandstorm Self-Hosted App Platform
free_limit: Free Apache-2.0 self-hosted application platform for installing and isolating web apps on a user-operated 64-bit Linux server; no vendor-hosted free compute is included.
watch_out: Requires your own x86-64 Linux server (at least 1 GB RAM, 2 GB recommended), maintenance, backups and hosting costs. Individual Sandstorm apps may have separate licenses or services. The optional Sandcats DNS service is not a free server.
